text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Opening of parliament today. New chairman expected to be appointed for parliamentary select committees. The opposition has nominated former finance minister John Dalli to head the Public Accounts Committee, which is chaired by the opposition.
- Membership of EU is best policy for Malta, says former Italian foreign minister Antonio Martino.
- Archbishop meets trade union representatives in annual meeting.
- General Workers' Union calls for improvements in pensions.
